title: Revolut says 58% of reported job scams globally came from Telegram in 2025, dwarfing other platforms for these cases, based on an analysis of 10B+ transactions (Aisha S Gani/Bloomberg)
summary: Aisha S Gani / Bloomberg: Revolut says 58% of reported job scams globally came from Telegram in 2025, dwarfing other platforms for these cases, based on an analysis of 10B+ transactions — Most job scams reported to finance app Revolut Ltd. last year started their journey on the Telegram messaging platform …
